Epidemiology Estimations of prevalence or incidence are
y
diﬃ  cult because diverticulosis, in most people, is asymptomatic.
Best estimates, however, indicate diverticulosis is most common
in Western and industrialized countries where it is thought that 
approximately 5% to 10% of the population will have diverticula
by age 50. Incidence will increase with age, with some estimates
as high as 65% to 70% in persons over the age of 85.131

mined, development of diverticulosis is related to low ﬁ ber
